title: Smart Automatic Attendance System(working on it)
description: An Android-based smart attendance system that automatically marks student attendance using an ESP8266 classroom Wi-Fi beacon. Teachers start an attendance session from their phone; students nearby scan for the beacon and mark themselves present — all verified server-side, hosted on Render, and stored in Neon PostgreSQL.

title: StudySphere AI
description: StudySphere AI is a full-stack AI-powered learning platform that integrates intelligent study tools into academic workflows. It enables AI-based note summarization, personalized quiz generation and editing, interactive 3D flashcards, an AI Tutor, and automated exam study planning. The platform also provides role-based workspaces for Students, Teachers, HODs, and Administrators, with a BYOK multi-provider AI architecture for flexible AI integration.

title: Level-Up – AI-Powered Mock Test Platform
description: An AI-powered mock test platform with Practice and Exam modes. Integrated AI-generated explanations and performance analysis for personalized learning. Designed responsive UI and secure backend for user management and test evaluation.

title: Fake News Detection
description: A machine learning-based web application to classify news as real or fake. Implemented data preprocessing and machine learning models, achieving high accuracy in classification.
